simple.meaning: חֹצֶן (chôtsen) is a Hebrew object word meaning “arm, lap.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Nehemiah 5:13. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֹצֶן (H2684) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H2684. chotsen חֹ֫צֶן noun masculine bosom ; — נָעַרְתִּי חָצְנִי Neh 5:13 I shook out my bosom (the bosom of my garment); בְּחֹ֫צֶן בָּנַיִךְ וְהֵבִיאוּ Isa 49:22 and they shall bring thy sons in the bosom (i.e. in the arms, clasped to the bosom, like infants; || עַלכָּֿתֵף ).
